text: From the e2afd67 landing review. WarOfTheGhostsCodecGoldenResourceSuite (JVM-only, needs classpath resources) carries the substantive leak check: per-sentence canaries from the recall atlas AND the source atlas, plus the title. The portable WarOfTheGhostsCodecGoldenSuite only asserts the whole transcript text is absent, which nearly any real leak would slip past. Move the canary loop into the portable suite - it needs no resource, it can scan the freshly encoded string - and leave the JVM suite owning only committed-resource byte equality + checksum. Small, and it makes the privacy claim hold on every platform the codec ships to. Owner: codec (codex-storymodel4s-root), after the parity repost.
